Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans and square footage; robust condition assessment covering major systems and infrastructure; connects condition data to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Facility Assessment, Appendix, and multiple site-specific assessments).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections using cohort survival method augmented by residential housing starts; includes capacity utilization data by site and grade; links enrollment projections to specific facility actions including new construction and reconfiguration (Demographics and Data Analysis, Classroom Standards and Loading, Phase I-IV Recommendations).

Educational Alignment.justification: Includes district educational goals and relates them to facilities; discusses educational specifications such as classroom standards and loading; connects facility projects to educational programs but coverage of programmatic shifts and technology integration is partial (Executive Summary, Classroom Standards and Loading, Educational Environment sections).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Mentions outdoor spaces such as playfields and hardscapes with some discussion of condition and need for improvements; limited detail on greening strategies or districtwide data on green space; no explicit connection to climate resilience or outdoor learning (Facility Assessments discuss playfields and landscaping but lack comprehensive greening strategy).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges natural occurring asbestos (NOA) and mitigation measures; references some site-specific environmental hazards; limited detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive districtwide climate resilience strategies (Facility Assessment Appendix, site-specific asbestos mitigation).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Discusses energy efficiency strategies including HVAC replacement, energy management systems, and solar estimates; references Title 24 and state goals; mentions energy resilience goals but lacks comprehensive districtwide resilience plan (Facility Assessment, Energy sections, and project cost estimates include solar).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed capital strategy with phased project prioritization, detailed cost estimates with contingencies, and multiple funding sources including bonds, developer fees, and state programs; includes financial hardship application strategy and long-term financial sustainability considerations (Financial Plan, Funding Options, and Phase I-IV Recommendations).
